meta.name: performance-reporter
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "generate an SEO report" or "出月报"; builds multi-metric stakeholder reports and dashboards spanning traffic, rankings, authority, and content progress. Not for raw ranking deltas — use rank-tracker. SEO报告/绩效仪表盘

copy.tagline: 生成SEO报告和绩效仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为利益相关者生成SEO和流量绩效报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate SEO reports and performance dashboards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate SEO and traffic performance reports for stakeholders

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能生成包含流量、排名、权威度、内容进展等多维度指标的SEO/GEO绩效报告或仪表盘。它会汇总数据、对比前后周期、计算ROI，并给出带优先级和预期影响的改进建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成SEO报告”、“出月报/周报”或“做汇报给老板的仪表盘”时触发。需要指定域名和时间范围。

say.text: 帮我生成example.com上个月的SEO绩效报告。
say.note: Claude会汇总流量、排名等数据并输出完整报告。

say.text: 出一下本周的流量月报，对比上月同期。
say.note: Claude会对比前后周期并标注变化。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to generate multi-metric SEO/GEO performance reports or dashboards covering traffic, rankings, authority, and content progress. It aggregates data, compares periods, calculates ROI, and produces prioritized recommendations with owners and expected impact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "generate an SEO report", "出月报/周报", or create a stakeholder dashboard. Requires a domain and optional date range.

say_en.text: Generate an SEO performance report for example.com for last month.
say_en.note: Claude will compile traffic, rankings, and other metrics into a full report.

say_en.text: Create a weekly traffic summary comparing to the prior week.
say_en.note: Claude will compute period-over-period deltas and highlight changes.

say_en.text: Generate a GEO visibility report for example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on AI citations and GEO opportunities.
